description: Implement, verify, and deploy a host MediaAssist plugin that converts audio/image/video into text when the LLM rejects multimodal input (HTTP 400). Use when media-assist placeholders appear, assistPluginStatus reports missing, listenContent/seeContent succeed but the next completion fails, or the user asks to install an ASR/OCR assist plugin. Triggers: media-assist, MediaAssist, multimodal 400, deployAssistPlugin, harness-plugins, libragent-plugin.
